summary: Adjusts hue, saturation, and value globally or within ranges centered around a start color.

key_params.name: startcolor
key_params.note: Color around which HSV selection is centered

key_params.name: hueoffset
key_params.note: Hue offset applied to selected pixels

key_params.name: parmcolorspace
key_params.note: Parameter color-space selector when working color space is active

key_params.name: parmreferencewhite
key_params.note: Parameter reference white when working color space is active

common_gotchas: Leaving ranges broad means the offset and multipliers affect the whole image.
Selection is centered on Start Color, so changing Start Color changes which pixels are adjusted.
Falloff expands and softens the selected range rather than changing the target color directly.
Multipliers can clip depending on output format and downstream color handling.
key_concepts: HSV Adjust TOP changes image colors in hue, saturation, and value space.
Hue Offset, Saturation Multiplier, and Value Multiplier affect all pixels when ranges remain broad.
Start Color centers range-limited edits around a chosen hue/saturation/value target.
Hue Range is in degrees, and a range of 360 affects all hues.
Saturation Range and Value Range are normalized from 0 to 1.
Falloff controls soften the selected hue, saturation, and value ranges.
